seoTitle: Transfer a GoDaddy Domain to Hostinger
metaDescription: Moving your domain to Hostinger? Learn how to unlock it, get the EPP/Auth code, disable WHOIS privacy, and monitor the transfer status.
intro: Transferring a domain from GoDaddy to Hostinger involves a handful of standard steps, from unlocking the domain to tracking the transfer until it completes. This guide covers the full process, including disabling WHOIS privacy and updating DNS settings if needed.

steps.heading: Unlock your domain in GoDaddy
steps.body: Log in to GoDaddy and disable the domain lock so the domain becomes eligible for transfer.

steps.heading: Obtain the EPP/Auth code
steps.body: Request the EPP or Auth code from GoDaddy, which Hostinger will need to verify the transfer request.

steps.heading: Disable WHOIS privacy if needed
steps.body: Turn off WHOIS privacy protection temporarily if it's interfering with the transfer verification process.

steps.heading: Initiate the transfer in Hostinger
steps.body: Log in to your Hostinger dashboard, start the domain transfer, and enter the EPP/Auth code when prompted.

steps.heading: Monitor the transfer status
steps.body: Keep an eye on the transfer status in Hostinger until it completes, updating DNS settings afterward if needed.

faq.question: Why do I need to disable WHOIS privacy for a transfer?
faq.answer: Some transfer verification steps require visible contact information, so WHOIS privacy sometimes needs to be temporarily turned off.

faq.question: How long does a GoDaddy to Hostinger transfer take?
faq.answer: Domain transfers commonly take about five to seven days to fully process, though it can vary.

faq.question: Will my website experience downtime during the transfer?
faq.answer: Typically no, since a registrar transfer usually doesn't interrupt hosting or DNS unless you also decide to change those settings.

faq.question: Do I need to update DNS after the transfer completes?
faq.answer: It depends on your setup — if you want Hostinger to also host your site, you may need to update DNS settings after the transfer finishes.
